segments.contextAfter: `action`: The action being overridden. Use  [`kSecTransformActionProcessData`](ksectransformactionprocessdata.md) to change the way that input data is processed into the output data. The default behavior is to simply copy the input data to the output attribute. Changing this behavior is really a special case of a [`SecTransformSetAttributeAction(_:_:_:_:)`](sectransformsetattributeaction(_:_:_:_:).md) action. Using [`kSecTransformActionProcessData`](ksectransformactionprocessdata.md) as the `action` overwrites any previously set [`kSecTransformActionAttributeNotification`](ksectransformactionattributenotification.md) action. Use [`kSecTransformActionInternalizeExtraData`](ksectransformactioninternalizeextradata.md) to change the way that custom externalized data is imported into the transform. The default behavior is to do nothing.
